gap: January birth-flower products are single stems, line art, personalized names or expensive handmade mugs; none found paints both January flowers together as a real-looking watercolor bouquet at print-on-demand prices. Angle: a hand-tied watercolor bouquet of ruffled carnations in four colors with white snowdrops (each with its green mark), eucalyptus and a satin bow, lettered 'Carnation & Snowdrop' so the art names the flowers without the month.
trend: Birth-month-flower gifts are a steady gift category (several stores carry 12-month ranges); January birthdays are shopped right after Christmas; watercolor florals are our strongest fit. If this sells, the other months follow as a series.
